description: Needs a SpaceNexus API key (a free key is enough). The full Launch Ledger record: every launch date change our ledger holds since recording began, one row per launch per UTC observation day, with the observation fields (live or catch-up, the catch-up reason, Launch Library 2's last-updated time), both dates at their precision and its basis, the size and kind of the move, and whether it counts as a slip. Filter by launch, provider, rocket, observation, kind and day; page with offset. The same rows as the free launch-slips dataset.

kind.description: Only this kind of move: slip, pull-in, adjust, firmed, loosened or placeholder.

launch.description: One launch: its name or mission (substring, e.g. "Starship Flight 14") or its Launch Library 2 id.

limit.description: How many rows to return (1 to 25).

observation.description: live: changes our sync saw when they happened; catch-up: changes it only caught up with late; all: both.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging (0 to 10000).

provider.description: Only launches by this provider (substring or common short name, e.g. "ULA", "CASC").

since.description: Only changes observed on or after this UTC day (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: launch_ledger_record
title: Launch Ledger full record
